scope: Permanent return-camera blackout development. Cached assigned-tag alignment is only eligible with fresh valid slow navigation. A bounded normal PX4 LAND can count as safe termination, never complete task or 7 mm slot success. Navigation-loss policy is separate.
selection_basis: The original successful-slot envelope is 7 mm. It leaves 18 mm in the separate 25 mm safe termination envelope for motion after a cached observation; this is a declared development bound, not estimator confidence or a task success relaxation.
